queries.sql:
select column_name
         from information_schema.columns
        where table_schema = ?
          and table_name = ?

SELECT "marker"."core_hash" AS "core_hash", "marker"."profile_hash" AS "profile_hash", "marker"."contract_json" AS "contract_json", "marker"."canonical_version" AS "canonical_version", "marker"."updated_at" AS "updated_at", "marker"."app_tag" AS "app_tag", "marker"."meta" AS "meta", "marker"."invariants" AS "invariants" FROM "prisma_contract"."marker" WHERE "marker"."space" = $?

SELECT "bakerySettings"."id" AS "id", "bakerySettings"."timezone" AS "timezone", "bakerySettings"."currencyCode" AS "currencyCode", "bakerySettings"."orderAcceptingEnabled" AS "orderAcceptingEnabled", "bakerySettings"."minimumPreparationMinutes" AS "minimumPreparationMinutes", "bakerySettings"."maximumAdvanceDays" AS "maximumAdvanceDays", "bakerySettings"."pickupSlotMinutes" AS "pickupSlotMinutes", "bakerySettings"."bakeryName" AS "bakeryName", "bakerySettings"."phone" AS "phone", "bakerySettings"."address" AS "address", "bakerySettings"."notificationEmail" AS "notificationEmail" FROM "public"."bakerySettings" WHERE "bakerySettings"."id" = $? LIMIT ?

SELECT "businessHours"."weekday" AS "weekday", "businessHours"."openMinute" AS "openMinute", "businessHours"."closeMinute" AS "closeMinute" FROM "public"."businessHours" WHERE ("businessHours"."bakerySettingsId" = $? AND "businessHours"."weekday" = $?) ORDER BY "businessHours"."openMinute" ASC

INSERT INTO "public"."actionRateLimitBucket"
      ("id", "keyHash", "action", "windowStart", "windowSeconds", "count", "expiresAt")
    VALUES
      ($?, $?, $?, $?::timestamptz, $?, ?, $?::timestamptz)
    ON CONFLICT ("keyHash", "action", "windowStart", "windowSeconds")
    DO UPDATE SET
      "count" = "actionRateLimitBucket"."count" + ?,
      "expiresAt" = EXCLUDED."expiresAt"
    RETURNING "count", "expiresAt"

SELECT "order"."id" AS "id", "order"."orderNumber" AS "orderNumber", "order"."status" AS "status", "order"."pickupAt" AS "pickupAt", "order"."totalMinor" AS "totalMinor", "order"."currencyCode" AS "currencyCode", "order"."payloadHash" AS "payloadHash" FROM "public"."order" WHERE "order"."idempotencyKey" = $?::uuid LIMIT ?

SELECT p."id" FROM "public"."product" p
    JOIN "public"."category" c ON c."id" = p."categoryId"
    WHERE p."id" IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($?::jsonb)::uuid)
    ORDER BY c."id", p."id" FOR SHARE OF p, c

SELECT "product"."allergenInfo" AS "allergenInfo", "product"."categoryId" AS "categoryId", "product"."createdAt" AS "createdAt", "product"."description" AS "description", "product"."id" AS "id", "product"."imageHeight" AS "imageHeight", "product"."imagePathname" AS "imagePathname", "product"."imageUrl" AS "imageUrl", "product"."imageWidth" AS "imageWidth", "product"."isActive" AS "isActive", "product"."isAvailable" AS "isAvailable", "product"."name" AS "name", "product"."priceMinor" AS "priceMinor", "product"."slug" AS "slug", "product"."sortOrder" AS "sortOrder", "product"."unitLabel" AS "unitLabel", "product"."updatedAt" AS "updatedAt", (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(?, CAST("category__rows"."createdAt" AS text), ?, "category__rows"."description", ?, "category__rows"."id", ?, "category__rows"."isActive", ?, "category__rows"."name", ?, "category__rows"."slug", ?, "category__rows"."sortOrder", ?, CAST("category__rows"."updatedAt" AS text))), json_build_array()) AS "category" FROM (SELECT "category"."createdAt" AS "createdAt", "category"."description" AS "description", "category"."id" AS "id", "category"."isActive" AS "isActive", "category"."name" AS "name", "category"."slug" AS "slug", "category"."sortOrder" AS "sortOrder", "category"."updatedAt" AS "updatedAt" FROM "public"."category" WHERE "category"."id" = "product"."categoryId") AS "category__rows") AS "category" FROM "public"."product" WHERE "product"."id" IN ($?::uuid)

SELECT "orderNotificationDelivery"."attempts" AS "attempts", "orderNotificationDelivery"."createdAt" AS "createdAt", "orderNotificationDelivery"."deliveredAt" AS "deliveredAt", "orderNotificationDelivery"."id" AS "id", "orderNotificationDelivery"."lastErrorCode" AS "lastErrorCode", "orderNotificationDelivery"."leaseUntil" AS "leaseUntil", "orderNotificationDelivery"."orderId" AS "orderId", "orderNotificationDelivery"."recipientType" AS "recipientType", "orderNotificationDelivery"."status" AS "status", "orderNotificationDelivery"."updatedAt" AS "updatedAt" FROM "public"."orderNotificationDelivery" WHERE "orderNotificationDelivery"."orderId" = $?::uuid
